name: 4'-methyl-α-pyrrolidinobutiophenone
summary: 4'-Methyl-α-pyrrolidinobutiophenone or MPBP is a stimulant compound which has been reported as a novel designer drug. It is closely related to pyrovalerone, being simply its chain-shortened homologue.

uses.text: 4'-Methyl-α-pyrrolidinobutiophenone or MPBP is a stimulant compound which has been reported as a novel designer drug.

pharmacology.en: Little has been published about it. Like pyrovalerone and other α-pyrrolidinophenones, it is thought to block the reuptake of dopamine and noradrenaline.
pharmacology.zh: 相關研究很少。一般認為它和吡咯戊酮及其他α-吡咯烷苯酮一樣，會阻斷多巴胺與正腎上腺素的回收。
pharmacology.zhHans: 相关研究很少。一般认为它和吡咯戊酮及其他α-吡咯烷苯酮一样，会阻断多巴胺与正肾上腺素的回收。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its family, the α-pyrrolidinophenones such as α-PVP, can cause a racing heart, raised blood pressure, overheating, insomnia, agitation, paranoia and a strong urge to keep redosing. Serious risks include psychosis, violent agitation, heart problems, seizures and dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。與它同家族的α-吡咯烷苯酮類藥物（例如α-PVP），可能引起心跳急促、血壓升高、體溫過高、失眠、躁動、多疑，以及想一再追加用藥的強烈衝動。嚴重風險包括精神病、激烈躁動、心臟問題、癲癇發作與成癮。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。与它同家族的α-吡咯烷苯酮类药物（例如α-PVP），可能引起心跳急促、血压升高、体温过高、失眠、躁动、多疑，以及想一再追加用药的强烈冲动。严重风险包括精神病、激烈躁动、心脏问题、癫痫发作与成瘾。

fact.en: It is pyrovalerone with one carbon trimmed from its side chain. Pyrovalerone itself was developed in the 1960s as a treatment for chronic fatigue and as an appetite suppressant.
fact.zh: 它就是把吡咯戊酮（pyrovalerone）的側鏈剪短一個碳。吡咯戊酮本身是在1960年代開發的，用於治療慢性疲勞與抑制食慾。
fact.zhHans: 它就是把吡咯戊酮（pyrovalerone）的侧链剪短一个碳。吡咯戊酮本身是在1960年代开发的，用于治疗慢性疲劳与抑制食欲。
